CREATE TABLE tag_chart_type_link ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, tag_id BIGINT NOT NULL, chart_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_tag_chart_type_link_tag_chart_type UNIQUE (tag_id, chart_type), CONSTRAINT fk_tag_chart_type_link_tag FOREIGN KEY (tag_id) REFERENCES tag (id) );
CREATE INDEX idx_tag_chart_type_link_tag ON tag_chart_type_link (tag_id);
